sections.title: A fourth meal joins the day
sections.content: You already have reggelizik, ebédel and vacsorázik from Unit 1 for the day's three main meals. étkezés is the general word for "a meal" or "eating" as an activity — useful whenever you're not naming breakfast, lunch or dinner specifically. And uzsonnázik ("to have an afternoon snack") is a fourth -ik verb, conjugated exactly like the others, that fills the gap between ebéd and vacsora.

items.spanish: Négy étkezés van egy napban: reggeli, ebéd, uzsonna és vacsora.
items.english: There are four meals in a day: breakfast, lunch, an afternoon snack, and dinner.

items.spanish: Iskola után uzsonnázunk, és később vacsorázunk.
items.english: We have an afternoon snack after school, and later we have dinner.

sections.content: uzsonnázom, uzsonnázol, uzsonnázik... conjugates exactly like zuhanyozik and reggelizik — new vocabulary, not new endings, the same reassurance A2 Unit 1 already gave you about this whole set of verbs.
